'''Alain Fuchs''' (10 April 1953 – 8 December 2024) was a Swiss-born French chemist. A [[Doctor of Science]] and Professor of Chemistry, he specialised in molecular simulation. Fuchs served as the president of [[Chimie ParisTech|Chimie ParisTech - PSL]] from 2006 to 2010. He also served as the president of the [[French National Centre for Scientific Research]] from 2010 to 2017.<ref name="lemondeunnouveaupatron">{{cite news|last1=Jacqué|first1=Philippe|title=Un nouveau patron pour le CNRS|url=http://www.lemonde.fr/societe/article/2010/01/14/un-nouveau-patron-pour-le-cnrs_1291882_3224.html|access-date=3 April 2016|work=Le Monde|date=14 January 2010}}</ref>{{'}}<ref>{{cite news|title= Anne Peyroche est nommée présidente du CNRS par intérim |url= http://www2.cnrs.fr/presse/communique/5275.htm |work= CNRS |date= 24 October 2017 |access-date= 24 October 2017}}</ref> Fuchs became an Officer of the [[Legion of Honour]] in 2014.<ref name="journalofficiel">{{cite journal|title=ORDRE NATIONAL DU MÉRITE|journal=Journal Officiel de la République Française|date=15 May 2014|url=http://www.legiondhonneur.fr/sites/default/files/onm_20140515.pdf|access-date=3 April 2016}}</ref>

From 24 October 2017 until 26 June 2024, Fuchs was president of [[PSL Research University|PSL University]] (Paris Sciences & Lettres).<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://www.univ-psl.fr/en/actualites/alain-fuchs-elected-president-psl|title=Alain Fuchs elected president of PSL {{!}} PSL|website=www.univ-psl.fr|language=en|access-date=9 October 2017|archive-date=9 October 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171009195548/https://www.univ-psl.fr/en/actualites/alain-fuchs-elected-president-psl|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{cite web | url=https://www.aefinfo.fr/depeche/714531-alain-fuchs-demissionne-de-la-presidence-de-psl | title=Alain Fuchs démissionne de la présidence de PSL- AEFinfo }}</ref>

== Biography ==
Alain Fuchs graduated as a Chemical engineer (1975) at [[EPFL]].<ref name=Educpro/> In 1983, he became a doctor in Physical Chemistry at [[Université Paris-Sud]] (now [[Paris-Saclay University]]; his dissertation was "Cristaux vitreux et transition vitreuse" (about glass crystals).<ref>Alain Fuchs ''Cristaux vitreux et transition vitreuse'' - [[Université Paris-Sud]] - 1983 – Doctoral advisor : Henri Szwarc  - Dissertation number: 1983PA112380 - [http://www.sudoc.fr/043134777 SUDOC website] - Worldcat : 490643197</ref> He was also a postdoctoral fellow at the [[University of Edinburgh]] (1984–1985).<ref>{{cite journal|language=French|url=http://www.industrie-techno.com/alain-fuchs-un-pedagogue-a-la-tete-du-cnrs.36343|author=Jean-François Preveraud|date=18 February 2015|website=Industrie&technologies|title=Alain Fuchs, un pédagogue à la tête du CNRS|access-date=23 April 2015|archive-date=4 July 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150704004548/http://www.industrie-techno.com/alain-fuchs-un-pedagogue-a-la-tete-du-cnrs.36343|url-status=dead}}</ref>

=== Career ===
Fuchs joined CNRS in 1985 as a research fellow. He became a research director in 1991. In 1995, he became chemistry professor at Université Paris-Sud. Between 2000 and 2005, he set up and directed the Laboratory of Physical Chemistry (UMR 8000) at Campus d'Orsay. He also worked as the President of the [[agrégation]] in chemistry from 1998 to 2001 and he directed the Section 13 of the Comité national de la recherche scientifique between 2004 and 2008. He was also Professor at the [[Université Pierre et Marie Curie]] (UPMC) in thermodynamics and statistical thermodynamics, intermolecular and surface forces, molecular simulation techniques, history of chemistry and physical chemistry. He served as the president of Chimie ParisTech from 2006 to 2010.<ref name=Educpro />

In January 2010, he was appointed President of the CNRS, succeeding [[Catherine Bréchignac]] (former President) d'Arnold Migus (former managing director).<ref name="monde2101">{{cite news|language=French|url=https://www.lemonde.fr/societe/article/2010/01/21/alain-fuchs-une-nouvelle-chimie-pour-le-cnrs_1294851_3224.html|author=Philippe Jacqué|title=Alain Fuchs: une nouvelle chimie pour le CNRS|newspaper=[[Le Monde]]|date=21 January 2010}}</ref><ref name=commCNRS>{{cite web|language=French|url=http://www2.cnrs.fr/presse/communique/1772.htm|title=Communiqué - Alain Fuchs est nommé président du CNRS|website=CNRS|date=20 January 2010|access-date=8 April 2015}}</ref><ref>Décret du 21 janvier 2010 portant nomination du président du Centre national de la recherche scientifique, JORF n°0018 du 22 janvier 2010 page 1427, texte n° 90</ref> Fuchs's mandate ended in 2014. After holding the position in interim for one month,<ref>{{in lang|fr}} Arrêté du 10 janvier 2014 portant attribution de fonctions au Centre national de la recherche scientifique, JORF n°0013 du 16 janvier 2014 page 760 texte n° 46</ref> he was appointed again by the Ministry of Higher Education.<ref>{{in lang|fr}} Décret du 27 février 2014 portant nomination du président du Centre national de la recherche scientifique, JORF n°0050 du 28 février 2014 page 3943 texte n° 112</ref>

In October 2017, Fuchs quit the position of CNRS President and became the President of [[PSL Research University|Université PSL]] (collegiate university including 9 members and 10 associate members).<ref name=":0" /> He left the position for personal reasons in June 2024.<ref name=":1" />

=== Death ===
Fuchs died in Paris on 8 December 2024, at the age of 71.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2024-12-11 |title=La mort du chimiste Alain Fuchs, ancien président du CNRS et grand promoteur de l'autonomie des universités |url=https://www.lemonde.fr/disparitions/article/2024/12/11/la-mort-du-chimiste-alain-fuchs-ancien-president-du-cnrs-et-grand-promoteur-de-l-autonomie-des-universites_6443080_3382.html |access-date=2024-12-14 |language=fr}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Décès du Pr Alain Fuchs, ancien président de l'Université PSL de 2017 à 2024 |url=https://curie.fr/actualite/institutionnel/deces-du-pr-alain-fuchs-ancien-president-de-luniversite-psl-de-2017-2024 |access-date=10 December 2024 |website=Institut Curie |language=fr}}</ref>

== Fields of research ==
His research activity was dedicated to the theory, modelling and molecular thermodynamics of fluids confined in various types of porous materials modeling and molecular simulation of confined fluids.<ref name=Educpro>{{cite web|language=french|author=Educpro|title=Alain Fuchs: Biography|year=2017|url=https://www.letudiant.fr/educpros/personnalites/fuchs-alain-325.html}}</ref> "Forced intrusion of water and aqueous solutions in microporous materials: from fundamental thermodynamics to energy storage devices"<ref>{{cite journal|author1=Guillaume Fraux|author2=François-Xavier Coudert|author3=Anne Boutin|author4=Alain Fuchs|title=Forced intrusion of water and aqueous solutions in microporous materials: from fundamental thermodynamics to energy storage devices|journal=[[Chem. Soc. Rev.]]|issue=46|pages=7421–7437|year=2017}}</ref> ([[Chem. Soc. Rev.]],46 (2017)) or "On the use of the IAST method for gas separation studies in porous materials with gate-opening behavior"<ref>{{cite journal|author1=Thomas D. Bennett|author2= Anthony K. Cheetham|author3= Alain H. Fuchs|author4= François-Xavier Coudert|title=Interplay between defects, disorder and flexibility in metal-organic frameworks|journal=Nature Chemistry|year=2017|volume= 9|issue=9|pages=11–16|doi= 10.1038/nchem.2691|pmid= 27995920|arxiv= 1904.09497|bibcode= 2017NatCh...9...11B|s2cid= 205297136}}</ref> (Adsorption, 24 (2018)) are part of his last recent and major publications.

Alain Fuchs was a member of the [[Academia Europaea]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ae-info.org/ae/User/Fuchs_Alain|title=Alain H. Fuchs|website=Academia Europaea|access-date=23 March 2015}}</ref> and he was a member of the editorial board of the journal ''[[Physical Chemistry Chemical Physics]]''.

Fuchs co-authored two books:
* {{cite book|language=French|author1= [[Anne Boutin]] | author2= Gilberte Dosseh | author3= Alain Fuchs |title=Éléments de thermodynamique. Cours et exercices corrigés pour le deuxième cycle de chimie, chimie-physique et sciences physiques|publisher=Elsevier Masson|year=1997}}
* {{cite book | language=French|author1=Georges Bram| author2= Françoise Chamozzi| author3= Alain Fuchs| author4=André Grelon| author5=Caroline Lanciano-Morandat| author6=Laurence Mordenti|title=La Chimie dans la société. Son rôle, son image|publisher=L'Harmattan|year=1995}}
